name: zzZ6_eyes

tests.name: this build carries the eye spacing controls

detail.note: an editor built before the fix reports neither cvar, and every profile below would then describe the OLD eyes while reading as a result for the new ones.

tests.name: each capture is a different picture

detail.note: thirty byte-identical PNGs passed a clause that counted files. In simulate mode there is no player camera, so the skins, the hour and the camera all changed and the photograph did not. A run whose pictures are all the same photographed the editor, not the game.

tests.name: every skin was photographed at every hour and distance the founder listed
Relay OG shows a dark gap between two eyes at every hour and distance

detail.note: the darkest point between the two brightest peaks, as a fraction of the dimmer peak. This cannot be passed by dimming the eyes: lowering both peaks lowers the trough with them and leaves the ratio unchanged, which is the failure the founder named explicitly.

tests.name: the two eyes are symmetrical about the centreline

detail.note: the dimmer peak over the brighter. The founder asked for them kept 'perfectly symmetrical around the visor/head centerline', and a lit figure photographed from slightly off-axis will never read 1.000, so this asks whether one eye is materially dimmer than the other.

tests.name: no other skin merges its eyes into one mass

detail.note: reported, not corrected. The founder's instruction is to inspect the others and not to redesign the ones that are already right, so this names the ones that are not.
